map.尸斑固定时间受什么影响？: What affects livor mortis fixation time?
map.受温度、贫血、休克、中毒（如氰化物樱桃红）、受压与否影响；贫血者尸斑淡、固定慢，: Affected by temperature, anemia, shock, poisoning (such as cherry-red in cyanide) and whether the area is compressed; in anemic subjects livor mortis is pale and fixes slowly, so read it with other indicators.
map.尸斑能判断原始体位吗？: Can livor mortis reveal the original body position?
map.能。尸斑出现于低下未受压部位，据此可反推死后原始体位，若与现体位不符提示移尸。: Yes. Livor mortis appears in low, uncompressed areas, so the original postmortem position can be inferred; if it conflicts with the current position, the body was likely moved.
